<a id="lion_cant_sleep"></a>
## The Ride of the Valkyries as Jungle: `lion_cant_sleep.yml`

Lion can't sleep: the Ride of the Valkyries as nineties jungle. The horn theme of the Ride of the
Valkyries (Richard Wagner, 1856) is public domain and is played as written, in its key and its nine-
eight time, from Claude's knowledge of the score, on horns as if sampled from a record; the chopped
breakbeats, the sub bass, the stabs and the arpeggios that answer are new.

<a id="south_florida_squad"></a>
## The Ride of the Valkyries as an Eighties Synthesizer Action Score: `south_florida_squad.yml`

South Florida squad: the Ride of the Valkyries as an eighties television action score for
synthesizers, after the Miami Vice theme (Jan Hammer). The horn theme of the Ride of the Valkyries
(Richard Wagner, 1856) is public domain and is played as written, in its key and its nine-eight
time, from Claude's knowledge of the score; the sequenced bass, the stabs, the tom-tom runs, the
licks and the solos are new, and nothing of the reference's own tune is quoted.
